description: Subcomponent of `v-heatmap` that renders the color scale legend.

props.cellSize: Sets size of each legend cell. A single value sets both width and height. Accepts `[width, height]` tuple.
props.activeBuckets: Indexes of the active threshold buckets. Other cells render as disabled.
props.labels: Text before and after the threshold cells. An empty string hides that label.
props.thresholds: Either a list of `{ min, color }` thresholds or a linear scale `{ from, to }`, shared with the parent `v-heatmap`. Linear scales render as a gradient bar.

events.click:threshold: Emitted when a threshold cell is clicked. Receives the bucket index.
